approvals.A2_successor_production_universe: cells 128-325 (198 cells) are the only successor production universe
approvals.A3_disjoint_union_composite_model: SUCCESSOR_PRODUCTION_RESULT = OLD_CARRYOVER (0-127) disjoint-union NEW_SUCCESSOR (128-325), covering exactly 0-325
approvals.A4_cells_124_127_admissible: cells 124-127 are admissible: reserved and started before the libc replacement, sealed under the frozen rule that stops admissions only, with verified envelopes
approvals.A5_q6_runtime_equivalence: Q6 (cells 318 and 323, two repeats each, scientific and all certificate hashes identical to the predecessor qualification under the new glibc) is sufficient runtime-equivalence evidence
approvals.A6_k4_composite_attestation: the K4 composite attestation of SUCCESSOR_CHECKPOINT_SPEC.md section 6 is an admissible additive consumer path, subject to conditions (b) and (c)
approvals.A7_predecessor_ledger_preserved: the predecessor HALTED ledger, journal, reaper, records and envelopes stay immutable historical evidence; its terminal disposition is never cleared or rewritten
approvals.A8_predecessor_authority_preserved: the old 128 records stay governed by predecessor authorization b8f11ec05efc2476f733dd989ae02b542dc9efa374f24fa0a27688d76ec2b329 and active countersignature 1ceb92d463d1332dfb26505143454b3c3fd87a611bc731372d9e227017682b07; nothing here relabels or mutates them

conditions.a: The successor checkpoint and launch preflight must enforce every binding in SUCCESSOR_CHECKPOINT_SPEC.md (sha256 6cc0d187ef0efd19d7eb5dbdaf61425f66cb055651f1ca1f72e4fae9934aa945), including the exact host and runtime identity (every fact of REQUALIFICATION_PROTOCOL.json host, all 11 system-library hashes, the producer identity and runtime contract), the containment POST_STATE, and the production universe exactly 128-325; any missing or differing binding refuses the launch.
conditions.b: The future composite audit must run the frozen prov_integrity.audit unchanged on the predecessor ledger and may tolerate exactly two predecessor audit issues: D_halt, only for the bound HOST_DRIFT stop, and D_unsettled_supervisor_runs, only for R20260913T115713Z-103963. Any other predecessor audit issue (including any A_, B_, C_ or D_open_attempts issue) must fail closed.
conditions.c: The future K4 composite attestation must use the successor checkpoint sha256 as producer_checkpoint_sha256, while the successor checkpoint itself binds the predecessor checkpoint dd4c89d773c411355d93d0d703e40c027f9913e11e116e4bfe35117f84b4baf2. Both provenance halves (each ledger state sha256, genesis entry sha256, authorization block and verified pairs) must be explicitly disclosed, and no record enters K4 unless its pair verified.
conditions.d: This countersignature is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT for production launch. Despite the frozen verdict label APPROVED_CARRYOVER_AND_SUCCESSOR_LAUNCH, CARRYOVER_AUTHORIZED = YES but PRODUCTION_LAUNCH_AUTHORIZED = NO until a valid successor checkpoint, a successor run authorization and the successor launch preflight all exist and pass.
conditions.e: Any reboot (a boot id different from the one bound at the successor checkpoint), provider maintenance, or host or runtime identity drift before or during successor production must fail closed: the launch is refused or admissions stop under the successor host guard.

statements.absolute_cap_may_not_be_raised: the absolute 300 CPU-h cap may only be confirmed or lowered, never raised
statements.no_duplicate_charging_of_old_cells: old cells enter only through the residual cap; the successor ledger has no import transition and never reads predecessor reaper records
statements.no_undercharging_of_predecessor_settleme: the unsettled predecessor supervisor run and the unmatched keeper exit are included in PREDECESSOR_SETTLED_CPU_US
statements.predecessor_cpu_cannot_be_reset: predecessor settled CPU is charged once, as ABSOLUTE_CAP_US - SUCCESSOR_RESIDUAL_CAP_US, and can never be reset, removed or offset
statements.qualification_cpu_excluded_but_disclosed: Q6 requalification CPU is excluded from the campaign cap and disclosed

opposing_clause_adjudication.context: Resume identity includes new checkpoint hash, exact cell-table hash, backend
opposing_clause_adjudication.purpose_preserved: cell table, producer identity (including backend-library hashes) and runtime contract are unchanged; the frozen drift rule requires requalification and a new checkpoint, not recomputation

reasons.R1_old_records_do_not_satisfy_successor_: the successor ledger universe is exactly 128-325; cells 0-127 are not rows in it and any successor attempt on them is refused, so no old record satisfies the new ledger's coverage
reasons.R2_old_records_remain_predecessor_author: the old records satisfy only the coverage of their own predecessor authorization and ledger, which admitted them before the drift; they are not re-authorized here
reasons.R3_no_resume_or_import_transition: there is no resume record, no import transition and no predecessor ledger or reaper row read into the successor; the clause governs resume identity and nothing is resumed
reasons.R4_successor_ledger_covers_only_128_325: every successor cell, including 318 and 323, is produced by a fresh attempt under the successor's own authorization-born genesis
reasons.R5_final_result_is_explicitly_governed_d: the final scientific result is the explicit, hash-bound, pre-launch disjoint union approved here, never a silent carry-over and never a claim that the predecessor ledger completed
reasons.R6_composite_k4_attestation_is_new_addit: the composite K4 attestation is a new additive consumer path approved by this countersignature; the predecessor sanctioned consumer path is unchanged for the predecessor ledger

k4_assembly_checkpoint.finding: NOT_PROHIBITIVE: integrity.CUSUM and k4_assembly.check_cusum_attestation require the attestation schema, cells_verified == 326, all scientific hashes verified, one producer identity and a producer checkpoint sha256; no clause requires one physical ledger

predecessor_drift_rule.finding: SATISFIED: a glibc change requires requalification (Q6 PASS) and a new checkpoint (the future successor checkpoint); it does not require recomputation

predecessor_sanctioned_consumer_path.finding: UNCHANGED_FOR_THE_PREDECESSOR: INTEGRITY_READY_FOR_ADJUDICATION requires a COMPLETE ledger, so the predecessor ledger alone is never disposition-bearing; composite consumption of its 128 pairs is a separate additive path allowed only under conditions (b) and (c)

ps1_generation_transition.finding: PRECEDENT_FOR_A_PERMANENTLY_AUTHORITATIVE_STOP_ONLY: it carried no scientific result (historical_results_affected NONE); the absence of a scientific carry-over precedent is not a blocker because this rule is explicit, frozen before the Q6 result, result-agnostic and independently reviewed
